profile.headline: Software Engineer III | Backend · Cloud (AWS) · ML
profile.summary:
I like building things that don't break when a million people show up. 

Distributed systems, event-driven architectures, data pipelines at scale is where I do my best work. There's something deeply satisfying about designing a system from a blank slate and watching it hold up under real pressure. 

My career has taken me from building enterprise file system infrastructure at AWS to owning loyalty and commerce backends processing millions of transactions at Fanatics. Along the way I've gotten comfortable with the full lifecycle: greenfield design, production incidents at 2am, large-scale data recovery, and everything in between.

Outside of work, I'm the kind of person who reads about things I don't need to know yet. Whether that's a new consensus algorithm, a paper on recommendation systems, or how a company I admire actually scaled. Curiosity is the habit I trust most.   

Always happy to connect with people building interesting things.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Built and owned end-to-end backend systems and features — from technical spike through deployment — for a large-scale loyalty, e-commerce and betting & gaming platform using event-driven pipelines, Kafka, and CRM integration.
• Designed and executed an end-to-end data migration pipeline across Cassandra, Snowflake, S3, and AWS EMR.
• Resolved multiple high-severity production bugs impacting customer rewards.
• Built monitoring dashboards and alerting infrastructure from scratch at platform launch.
• Built an end-to-end testing suite covering the complete customer lifecycle across distributed services.

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
• Built predictive maintenance models (Random Forest, XGBoost) to forecast equipment failures, reducing downtime by 20%.
• Designed data pipelines using Apache Spark and AWS Glue for large-scale manufacturing data collection and preprocessing.
• Developed ML models for customer churn prediction and demand forecasting, contributing to a 15% reduction in churn over 6 months.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Built and shipped features for AWS FSx for Windows File Server — a managed file system service serving thousands of enterprise customers.
• Reduced cloud service operator load by 20% from improving a core dependency integration.
• Led filesystem lifecycle and security enhancements; built a backend monitoring system to detect and alarm on critical auditing failures.
• Participated in hiring, mentored new hires and interns, and served as Scrum Leader.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Assisted in teaching the graduate course 'Large Scale Analytics,' covering Apache Spark, PageRank, and SVD.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed ASP.NET e-commerce web applications for clients using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL Server, and REST APIs.
• Designed modules based on direct client interactions and delivered tailored content management solutions.

projects.title: Credit Card Validator
projects.description: Built a credit card validation system in Java using Gang of Four design patterns (Factory, Strategy); supports CSV, JSON, and XML output formats with extensible class design.

projects.title: SWIFT — Intelligent Slack Support Bot
projects.description: Built a Slack plugin using Stanford NER to automatically route support requests (IT, facilities, medical, financial) to the correct channel.
